correctness.rationale: For ordered full binary trees of n internal vertices, including the size-zero leaf, direct subtree-depth reversal gives F(z;u,v)=u+z(F(z;u^{-1},v)^2+(v-1)u^{-2}). Its mixed derivatives produce M=1/(2-s), B=z/s and J=-2z/(2-s)-2z^2/[s(2-s)^2], s=sqrt(1-4z). Independent Puiseux expansion gives M=1/2+s/4+s^2/8+s^3/16+... and J=-1/(32s)-9/32-11s/128+..., yielding E Delta=-1/8-9/(64n)+..., E H=n/4+3/8+..., E Delta H=-n/32+3/256+..., hence Cov=3/32+O(1/n). A second-u derivative yields Var Delta~9n/8, cherry bivariate Catalan derivative yields Var H~n/16, giving n Corr -> 1/(2sqrt2); correlation only n>=3. Singularities outside z=1/4 are subdominant. Explicit enumeration of all ordered Catalan shapes for n=3..6 reproduced 24/25,-24/49,4/7,-12/121. These finite enumerations are corroboration, not proof of the limits.
